reproducibility_gaps: No software license, dependency manifest, Python version, package versions, lockfile, or complete environment specification is supplied; README installation covers only PyTorch generically and VTK via pip.

The four flow-training entrypoints use author-local absolute input directories rather than the bundled Data paths, and the 3D inputs are available only through an unversioned external Google Drive pointer.

No Results directory, trained checkpoint, run log, saved prediction, numeric target table, or tolerance is bundled; the three Torch2VTK helpers require absent checkpoints and additional author-local paths.

The optional 3D WSS function concatenates only x and y before calling three-input networks, while the default path disables WSS plotting and writes only velocity and pressure; the supplied helper does not materialize the paper's 3D WSS evaluation as written.
No CLI, configuration file, portable run command, input-path mapping, or output-directory creation workflow is documented.
PyTorch/NumPy/CUDA seeds and deterministic-backend settings are absent despite random initialization, shuffled DataLoaders, and random viscosity initialization.
The four VTK and four VTU payloads and external 3D data remained unopened under the static boundary, and paper results were not recomputed.
notes: R1 preserves complete source, five identified training entrypoints, substantial bundled 2D inputs, mostly paper-aligned architecture/training details, primary-paper evaluation targets, and basic README installation guidance while withholding R2 because one substantially specified and portable environment/install/data workflow is unavailable.
No scientific workload or VTK/VTU/model payload was executed, deserialized, or opened; R5 remains prohibited.
